title: The Pete Born Impact Award: Dame Pat McGrath
summary: Makeup artist Dame Pat McGrath, the 2026 Beauty Inc Pete Born Impact Award honoree, has changed the face of beauty over the course of her three-decade-long career.

extraction.key_fact: 메이크업 아티스트 팻 맥그라스가 뷰티 잉크의 피트 본 임팩트 어워드 수상자로 선정됐다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Makeup artist Dame Pat McGrath, the 2026 Beauty Inc Pete Born Impact Award honoree, has changed the face of beauty over the course of her three-decade-long career.
